title: Student Assistant, Contract & Local Manufacturing Drug Product
location: Høje-Taastrup, Capital Region of Denmark, DK
description_md:
# Are you ready to turn ideas into clear communication and practical business support?

Are you a proactive student who enjoys bringing structure to varied tasks, creating strong presentations and collaborating across an international organisation? We are looking for a Student Assistant to join Contract & Local Manufacturing Drug Product (CLM DP) Business Support and contribute to a broad range of activities across operational excellence and the wider business support function.

This is an opportunity to build hands-on business experience alongside your studies, take ownership of meaningful assignments and work with colleagues across different areas of the organisation.

# The position

As our Student Assistant, you will support both recurring activities and ad hoc assignments. Your tasks will vary, so you should enjoy switching between priorities, working with different stakeholders and turning unstructured information into clear, useful outputs.

Your responsibilities may include:

* Creating and improving PowerPoint presentations and other communication materials.
* Supporting workshops and helping consolidate key outputs and follow-up materials.
* Contributing to business development and operational excellence activities.
* Drafting internal communications, emails, newsletters or similar materials.
* Coordinating recurring activities and providing general business support.
* Helping build and coordinate a network for student assistants and interns across the VP area, including networking activities and knowledge-sharing sessions.
* Using your initiative to support ad hoc tasks where the starting point may not always be fully defined.

# Qualifications

We are looking for a student who is curious, dependable and comfortable taking responsibility. You do not need previous professional experience, but you should be motivated to learn and contribute.

We expect that you:

* Are currently studying Business Administration or a similar relevant field.
* Have at least one year remaining in your studies.
* Communicate clearly and professionally in written and spoken English.
* Have strong PowerPoint and presentation-creation skills.
* Are structured and able to manage your time and priorities alongside your studies.
* Can work independently while knowing when to seek guidance.
* Are proactive, flexible and attentive to detail.
* Enjoy collaborating with different people and are comfortable coordinating activities.

It would be an advantage if you have an interest in AI, internal communication, workshop support or business development.

# About the department

You will join CLM DP Business Support in an international working environment. The role is anchored in Operational Excellence while supporting the broader business support function, giving you exposure to colleagues and activities across CLM DP. You will receive guidance while also being encouraged to take ownership and bring your own ideas to the work.

# Working at Novo Nordisk

At Novo Nordisk, we value curiosity, collaboration and the ambition to make a meaningful difference. In this student role, you will have the opportunity to develop your professional skills, learn how a global organisation operates and contribute to work that matters to the team.

# Apply now

If this sounds like an opportunity for you, we would be happy to hear from you. Please submit your application and tell us how your studies, skills and motivation connect with this Student Assistant opportunity.

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and encourage qualified applicants with different backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
